title: Small features matter: Robust representation for world models

contributions.purpose: 解决基于模型的强化学习(MBRL)中像素级重构世界模型偏向主要外生(exogenous)特征、忽略微小但关键的内生(endogenous)信息(如 Breakout 中仅 1/4096 像素的球)的问题
contributions.mechanism: 提出在嵌入空间用时间预测(joint embedding forward prediction / Augmented Temporal Contrast, ATC)损失作为辅助损失,加到 DreamerV3 架构上;对观测做随机 shift 增强,通过预测前向 K 步学习联合嵌入表征
contributions.evaluation: 定性:方法学到对世界模型和策略训练都有用的内生表征(Breakout 球的可视化重构,Figure 2)
contributions.domain: 强化学习 / 基于模型的强化学习(世界模型表征学习)
contributions.source_quote: We introduce joint embedding forward prediction loss as an auxiliary loss for world model representation learning.

contributions.purpose: 验证方法在标准样本效率基准上学到对 MBRL 有用的表征
contributions.mechanism: 在 Atari100k(26 游戏,10 万环境步)上以 human mean/median/IQM/optimality gap/probability of improvement 等指标对比 SimPLe/TWM/IRIS/DreamerV3
contributions.evaluation: 在 11 个游戏取得最佳,在 18 个游戏上优于或持平 DreamerV3;optimality gap 0.473 小于 DreamerV3;human normalized mean/median/IQM 显著优于其他 baseline(但相对 DreamerV3 的 probability of improvement 优势较窄)
contributions.domain: 强化学习 / Atari100k 基准
contributions.source_quote: We empirically show that our method built on DreamerV3 learns useful representation for MBRL in the Atari100k benchmark.

contributions.purpose: 验证方法对外生干扰信息的鲁棒性
contributions.mechanism: 在 Atari 帧注入像素噪声,并在 Distracting Control Suite(给 DMC 任务加动态背景,分 easy/medium/hard)上对比 DreamerV3(Cheetah run 三难度)
contributions.evaluation: easy 任务两者相当;难度升高后本方法对动态背景更鲁棒,分数下降幅度小于 DreamerV3
contributions.domain: 强化学习 / 鲁棒表征
contributions.source_quote: We empirically show that our method learns a robust representation by evaluating on the Distracting Control Suite Benchmark.

contributions.purpose: 研究前向预测步数 K 对样本效率的影响
contributions.mechanism: 消融:在 Breakout/Krull/Ms.Pac-Man 上比较 K∈{4,8,12}
contributions.evaluation: 动态复杂的游戏(Krull、Ms.Pac-Man)偏好更大 K,简单游戏(Breakout)偏好更小 K;与 Mattes et al.(2024)一致。尽管 K 重要,所有实验仍固定 K=4
contributions.domain: 强化学习 / 超参分析
contributions.source_quote: We study the role of forward prediction steps for sample efficiency.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our method is the closest to the work of Stooke et al. (2021), although our work finds its purpose in the context of world models. It can also be considered as a variant of Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) (LeCun, 2022; Assran et al., 2023) with augmented input frames.

we propose an auxiliary loss incorporated into the DreamerV3 architecture (Hafner et al., 2023). Specifically, we augment observations by applying random shifts and learn a joint-embedding representation by predicting forward steps.
Following Stooke et al. (2021), we utilize the components below in the forward predictive architecture.
The inspiration in our method lies in the findings of Nayebi et al. (2023). This work highlights the brain's ability to anticipate future events based on adaptable visual representations.

notes: 存在平局/负结果与坦承 caveat(rejected 论文):(1)Atari100k 上相对 DreamerV3 仅『优于或持平 18 游戏』,probability of improvement 相对 DreamerV3 margin 较窄——非全面碾压;(2)Distracting Control easy 难度与 DreamerV3 相当,仅难任务才显优势;(3)消融显示 ATC+shift 在 Krull 上影响可忽略(negligible);(4)K=4 固定但作者承认 K 很重要。作者自陈 limitation:因算力受限仅 3 seeds、更少步数/更少评估;方法非 task-specific learner。定位为 Stooke et al.(2021)ATC 在世界模型语境的应用 + JEPA 变体。注:此为匿名双盲/under review 版本(该 id 决定为 reject)。
